questions.question: On this day in 1822, which royal figure was proclaimed the first emperor of Brazil?
questions.explanation: Pedro I of Brazil was proclaimed emperor on 12 October 1822, ruling until his abdication in 1831.
questions.context:
On this day in 1822: Pedro I of Brazil is proclaimed the emperor.
Pedro I of Brazil (Emperor of Brazil (1822–31) and King of Portugal (1826)): Dom Pedro I, known in Brazil and in Portugal as "the Liberator" or "the Soldier King" in Portugal, was the founder and first ruler of the Empire of Brazil from 1822 to 1831 and King of Portugal in 1826.

questions.question: Which American actor directed the 2026 crime thriller film Animals, which he also starred in alongside Kerry Washington and Steven Yeun?
questions.explanation: Animals was directed and co-written by Ben Affleck, who also features in the lead cast.
questions.context: Animals (2026 film) (2026 film by Ben Affleck): Animals is a 2026 American crime thriller film directed by Ben Affleck and written by Affleck, Connor O. McIntyre and Billy Ray. It stars Affleck, Kerry Washington, Gillian Anderson, Adriana Paz with Luis Gerardo Méndez, and Steven Yeun. The film received negative reviews from critics.

questions.question: Which Spanish singer and songwriter graduated with a musicology degree from the Catalonia College of Music in 2017?
questions.explanation: Rosalía developed a passion for traditional Spanish folk music at 14 and went on to complete her degree in musicology in 2017.
questions.context: Rosalía (Spanish singer-songwriter (born 1992)): Rosalía Vila Tobella, known mononymously as Rosalía, is a Spanish singer-songwriter and actress. She has been described as an "atypical pop star" due to her genre-bending musical style. After being enthralled by Spanish folk music at age 14, she studied musicology at the Catalonia College of Music and graduated in 2017.

questions.question: Adapted from the 1952 John Steinbeck novel, which actress stars in the 2026 limited series East of Eden created by Zoe Kazan?
questions.explanation: Florence Pugh stars in the 2026 Netflix television adaptation of John Steinbeck's novel East of Eden.
questions.context: East of Eden (2026 miniseries) (American period drama miniseries by Zoe Kazan): East of Eden is a 2026 American historical drama television limited series created by Zoe Kazan, starring Florence Pugh. It is adapted from the 1952 novel by John Steinbeck and premiered on Netflix on October 1, 2026. It received generally positive reviews from critics.

questions.question: For which Premier League football club does Welsh international forward Lewis Koumas play?
questions.explanation: Lewis Koumas represents the Wales national side internationally and plays club football as a forward for Liverpool.
questions.context: Lewis Koumas (Wales international footballer (born 2005)): Lewis Terence Koumas is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Premier League club Liverpool. Born in England, he plays for the Wales national team.
